His filings list Marvell shares bought on October thirteenth and October twenty first, each for one thousand to fifteen thousand dollars. Both were disclosed November ninth.

Here's Marvell since September. It peaked in early October, and both of those buys came after that. Then, in six trading days, it lost almost forty seven percent... including a sixteen percent drop on November fifth alone. Since the later buy, it's down almost thirty seven percent.

post.title: Ro Khanna's filings show Marvell buys. Down 42% since
post.description:
Rep. Ro Khanna's STOCK Act filings show buys of Marvell Technology (MRVL) shares on Oct 13 and Oct 21, each $1K–$15K. Since the Oct 13 buy, Marvell is down 42.5%.

Oct 13 · Shares · BUY · $1K–$15K
Oct 21 · Shares · BUY · $1K–$15K

Disclosed Nov 9.

Marvell since then, using closing prices: down 42.5% from the Oct 13 close and 36.8% from the Oct 21 close, to $154.60 on Nov 9. From the Oct 28 close to the Nov 5 close it fell 46.9% in six trading days, including 16.4% on Nov 5 alone.

His earlier filings also show a Marvell buy on Aug 7 and a sale on Sep 11, each $1K–$15K.

Would you have bought more, or sold? Tell me in the comments.
